problemi.hero.title: Real Problems, Custom Solutions
problemi.hero.subtitle: We don't sell services. We solve specific problems.
problemi.intro.text: If you recognize yourself in one of these situations, a diagnosis could be the first step to solve it.
problemi.problema1.title: Time wasted on repetitive manual tasks
problemi.problema1.description: Your team spends hours doing things that could be automated: data entry, report generation, notifications, updates.
problemi.problema1.impatto: Less time for strategic work, higher costs, higher risk of human error
problemi.problema2.title: Systems that don't communicate
problemi.problema2.description: You have multiple tools (CRM, ERP, e-commerce, accounting) that don't talk to each other. Data is duplicated or lost.
problemi.problema2.impatto: Inconsistent information, wasted time, poor decisions based on incomplete data
problemi.problema3.title: Unreliable or outdated data
problemi.problema3.description: You can't trust the numbers you see. Reports are outdated or require manual aggregation from multiple sources.
problemi.problema3.impatto: Reactive (not proactive) decisions, missed opportunities, operational chaos
problemi.problema4.title: Difficulty scaling the business
problemi.problema4.description: What worked with 10 customers doesn't work with 100. Every new customer creates exponential complexity.
problemi.problema4.impatto: Bottlenecks, quality loss, inability to grow without proportionally increasing costs
problemi.problema5.title: Dependence on specific people
problemi.problema5.description: Only one person knows how a critical process works. If they're absent, everything stops.
problemi.problema5.impatto: Business risk, inability to delegate, inability to grow the team
problemi.problema6.title: Poor customer experience
problemi.problema6.description: Customers have to repeat information, wait for manual responses, or navigate confusing systems.
problemi.problema6.impatto: Lost customers, bad reputation, competitive disadvantage
problemi.problema7.title: Data scattered across multiple files
problemi.problema7.description: Excel spreadsheets, shared documents, emails with attachments. No single source of truth.
problemi.problema7.impatto: Version conflicts, data loss, inability to analyze trends or generate insights
problemi.problema8.title: Security and compliance issues
problemi.problema8.description: Sensitive data isn't protected. You don't know who has access to what. You're not compliant with regulations.
problemi.problema8.impatto: Legal risk, reputational damage, potential fines and sanctions
problemi.final_cta.title: Recognize any of these problems?
problemi.final_cta.subtitle: Start with a diagnosis. We'll help you understand what's really going on.

esperienza.named.title: Named Experiences
esperienza.named.subtitle: Systems we designed and built starting from real diagnostic processes.
esperienza.named.subtitle2: Custom paths shaped by real problems and real operational constraints.
esperienza.named.intro: Below are some concrete systems and platforms we have designed and built in real contexts. Each experience reflects a specific starting point, a clear problem, and a tailored approach.
esperienza.named.safefleet.title: SafeFleet
esperienza.named.safefleet.description: A custom system developed to address concrete challenges in fleet operations, document control, and regulatory compliance, where visibility and reliability were critical requirements.
esperienza.named.navenza.title: Navenza
esperienza.named.navenza.description: An internal management platform designed to bring structure and clarity to complex operational processes, improving control over data, workflows, and day-to-day activities.
esperienza.named.pinguito.title: Pinguito
esperienza.named.pinguito.description: A custom platform created to automate fragmented processes and support scalable operations, starting from the need to reduce manual work and operational friction.
esperienza.named.method_note: Each experience is the result of a diagnostic process applied to a specific context and set of needs.
esperienza.intro.text: These are real examples (anonymized) of problems we've solved. Your situation is unique, but the patterns are often similar.
esperienza.named_experiences.title: Named Experiences
esperienza.named_experiences.subtitle: Systems built from real diagnostic processes.
esperienza.named_experiences.intro: These experiences represent projects that, starting from concrete and well-diagnosed problems, have been transformed into structured and reusable systems in similar contexts.
esperienza.named_experiences.case_intro: Experience developed in a real context, following an in-depth diagnosis of operational needs.
esperienza.diagnosed_cases.title: Cases Solved with Diagnosis
esperienza.diagnosed_cases.subtitle: Problems clarified and addressed through proper analysis, before deciding how to intervene.
esperienza.diagnosed_cases.intro: Each case represents a real situation where the main value was bringing clarity: identifying the true problem, defining priorities, and choosing the right direction. Your situation is unique, but the emerging patterns are often recurring.
esperienza.diagnosed_cases.key_phrase: Not all cases become a named experience. But every named experience is born from a well-diagnosed case.
esperienza.safefleet.problema: Trucking company managing a fleet without centralized control over driver documentation, attendance, tire management, and vehicle maintenance.
esperienza.safefleet.soluzione: Fleet management platform integrating driver documentation, attendance tracking, tire lifecycle management, and comprehensive vehicle oversight.
esperienza.safefleet.risultato: Complete fleet visibility, automated driver compliance, optimized tire management, and streamlined attendance control.
esperienza.navenza.problema: Freight forwarding operations managing container shipments with fragmented quotes, no port tracking, and inefficient WhatsApp-based communication.
esperienza.navenza.soluzione: Container shipping platform with integrated forwarder quotes, real-time port tracking, and automated WhatsApp communication for shipment updates.
esperienza.navenza.risultato: Centralized quote management, real-time shipment visibility, automated client communications, and improved operational efficiency.
esperienza.pinguito.problema: Marketing agency managing multiple client social media accounts across TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook, plus email campaigns, all manually.
esperienza.pinguito.soluzione: Social media management platform for multi-client operations with campaign scheduling across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and integrated email marketing.
esperienza.pinguito.risultato: Centralized multi-client management, automated campaign scheduling, cross-platform publishing, and streamlined email campaigns.
esperienza.case1.problema: E-commerce company with 3 different systems (shop, warehouse, accounting) that didn't communicate
esperienza.case1.soluzione: Custom integration with automatic synchronization and centralized dashboard
esperienza.case1.risultato: 95% reduction in data entry time, zero sync errors, 30% faster order processing
esperienza.case2.problema: Service company spending 15 hours/week generating manual reports from Excel files
esperienza.case2.soluzione: Automated system with real-time dashboard and scheduled reports
esperienza.case2.risultato: Time saved reinvested in business development, more accurate and timely data
esperienza.case3.problema: B2B business with an onboarding process that took 2-3 weeks per client
esperienza.case3.soluzione: Automated onboarding platform with progressive forms and notifications
esperienza.case3.risultato: Onboarding reduced to 3 days, better customer experience, ability to scale
esperienza.case4.problema: Manufacturing company unable to track production status in real-time
esperienza.case4.soluzione: Custom tracking system with mobile app for operators
esperienza.case4.risultato: Real-time visibility, 40% reduction in delays, proactive quality management
esperienza.case5.problema: Consulting firm with a customer management process entirely based on emails and Excel
esperienza.case5.soluzione: Lightweight custom CRM integrated with email and calendar
esperienza.case5.risultato: No more lost information, complete client history, ability to delegate to new resources
esperienza.case6.problema: Marketplace with customer support overwhelmed by repetitive questions
esperienza.case6.soluzione: AI chatbot for first-level support, integrated with existing ticketing system
esperienza.case6.risultato: 70% of questions resolved automatically, team focused on complex cases
